events.verdict: Embiid (PHI) legally contests Tillman's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) legally contests Minott's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) secures the rebound and the contact with Pritchard (BOS) is incidental.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Brown (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Edgecombe's (PHI) path and absorbs the contact.
Edgecombe (PHI) maintains a forearm against White's (BOS) side as he moves alongside him. As White enters his shooting motion, Edgecombe removes his arm.
Embiid (PHI) turns slightly as he sets the screen on Pritchard (BOS) and the contact is marginal.
Tillman (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position defending Embiid (PHI) in the post.
Minott (BOS) legally contests Edgecombe's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path and does not deliver contact.
Maxey (PHI) briefly has an arm around Brown (BOS) before immediately removing it as he enters his shooting motion.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) swipes down and makes contact to Brown's (BOS) arm after the release of his jump shot attempt that is more than marginal.
White (BOS) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) driving shot attempt and the marginal contact is created by Maxey placing his off-arm against White.
Boston signals for and is granted a timeout while Pritchard (BOS) is in possession of the ball.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Brown (BOS).
Brown (BOS) moves forward into Maxey (PHI), initiating illegal body contact during the loose ball.
Embiid (PHI) establishes a screening position in Minott's (BOS) path and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Tillman (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during Maxey's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) commits a take foul on Minott (BOS).
